release_notes: v0.5.0-rc11: Jobs-mode batch progress now shows actively processing stages (Local, STT, AI Analysis, Retry Wait, Saving) instead of leaving work under Pending, with a Processing tooltip breakdown. Processed Calls status facets are scoped correctly to the current batch/month, and Not Connected filtering now uses canonical connection status. Compliance: Railway/API agent-name results are authoritative — blank API agent names are no longer replaced using transcript regex, and customer-confirmation text cannot be converted into the spoken agent name (Phase 1 customer-versus-agent attribution protection). Updates in place; no data-model changes. Prerelease build for controlled RC validation.
